assessment.what_changed_en: Changed the end of Risto Ryti's presidential term in the infobox and resignation narrative from 1 August 1944 (when he submitted his resignation so Finland could disavow his personal pact with Ribbentrop) to 4 August 1944 (when Parliament swore in Mannerheim).
assessment.uncertainty_note: Both dates reflect real constitutional milestones in August 1944: Ryti resigned on 1 August (Prime Minister Linkomies acted as head of state in the interim), and Mannerheim took office by special law on 4 August.
assessment.historical_note_en: Ryti's resignation on 1 August 1944 was a pivotal diplomatic manoeuvre enabling Finland to argue that the June 1944 Ryti–Ribbentrop commitment not to seek a separate peace bound Ryti personally rather than his successor Mannerheim.
